high_level_description: The image features a person standing against a plain white backdrop, which creates a minimalist and clean aesthetic. The individual is wearing a sleeveless, form-fitting white dress with a textured, ribbed pattern that extends from the top to the mid-thigh. The dress has a unique design element: it transitions into a series of long, flowing white fringes at the bottom, adding a dynamic and elegant touch to the outfit. The person is also wearing thigh-high white boots with a high heel, which complement the dress and enhance the overall look.
